heat.normal_basis: Station normal: mean hours of mandated rest a worker for this calendar month, 2000 to 2024, from NEA WBGT where observed and corrected ERA5 rebuild elsewhere.

rain.normal_basis: Station normal: mean rain hours a worker for this calendar month, 2000 to 2024, estimated from the nearest MSS daily record (calibrated on 484 station-days where NEA 5-minute gauges and MSS daily records overlap).

haze.note: No allowance for haze. 20 h a year limit.

receipt_lines: Lim Landscaping Pte Ltd, August 2026. Heat station: Bishan Stadium (S128). Rain gauge: Ang Mo Kio Avenue 10 (S216). Haze: central region PSI.
Heat rest owed: 2.00 h a worker. Normal plus 25%: 0.15 h. Insured: 1.85 h.
Heavy rain: 0.00 h a worker. Normal plus 25%: 3.53 h. Insured: 0.00 h.
Haze: 0.00 h. No allowance for haze.
1.85 h x S$8 x 20 workers = S$296, by PayNow to your UEN by Mon 07 Sep 2026 (5th working day).
To dispute a reading, reply to this receipt. Disputes are data checks. You can also go to FIDReC.
